content: अनिलः [अनिति जीवति अनेन, अन् इलच् <ls>Uṇ. 1. 54</ls>] .²1 Wind; वायुरनिलममृतमथेदम् <ls>Īśop. 17</ls>. प्राणानामनिलेन वृत्तिरुचिता <ls>Ś. 7. 12</ls>; स सखा दीप इवानिलाहतः <ls>Ku. 4. 30</ls>. (The number of winds is 7:-- आवहो निवहश्चैव उद्वहः संवहस्तथा . विवहः प्रवहश्चैव परिवाहस्तथैव च .. and these are again subdivided into 7 divisions, the total number being 49). .²2 The god of wind. .²3 One of the subordinate deities, 49 of whom form the class of winds. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the 8 Vasus, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} the fifth. .²5 The wind in the body, one of the humours; ˚हन्, ˚हृत्, ˚घ्न. .²6 Rheumatism or any disease referred to disorder of the wind. .²7 The letter य्. .²8 Symbolical expression for the number 49. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of the lunar asterism स्वाति. .²10 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu (तस्य प्राणात्मना सर्वदेहधारणात् तथात्वम्).
